question: Queue item 20261030-1045-expand-crawler-scraper-47c4-u01-q01: which plan and which search rate limit does a Valyu account that holds only signup credits report? The plan tab of the billing page, `valyu account whoami` (org and tier) and the `plan` and `limit.requests_per_second` fields of a keyed 429 body show it; a keyed burst of searches above 5 a second would also show whether the answer is 429 or 403 and whether a cap of 86,400 requests a day applies. The same sign-up shows whether registration asks for anything beyond an email address, such as a phone number.
why: unverified: behind a sign-up. No public page names the plan of a signup-credit-only account: the pricing page lists the signup credit in its Pay As You Go plan card, the documented 429 example gives Pay-as-you-go 5 search requests a second and Ridiculously Cheap 10, and the OpenAPI description on the Search reference page still states 10 requests a second with bursts up to 20, 86,400 requests a day and a 403 answer, which the API overview contradicts with per-plan limits answered 429 and no daily quota. Reading the value needs an account, which is the operator's step.
